'$'''trap '''trap - TERM INT HUP USR1, 
 returnVal=1, 
 kill -USR1 $(cat </dev/null "'''"${tmpDir}"'''"/.run/p* 2>/dev/null), 
 kill -TERM $(cat </dev/null "'''"${tmpDir}"'''"/.run/p* 2>/dev/null) '''"${PID0}" TERM' (148,375 us, 0.01%)
